form_analysis.feedback: Excellent, comprehensive aftercare form specifically for Vampire Facial (PRP Microneedling). Well-structured with clear time phases, detailed symptom expectations, emergency protocols, and long-term guidance. Includes both short-term and long-term care instructions.

form_data.treatment_description: This treatment uses your body’s own platelet-rich plasma, combined with microneedling, to stimulate collagen production, improve skin texture, and promote a youthful glow.
form_data.introduction: Proper aftercare is essential to maximise results and minimise complications.

sections.title: Redness and Warmth
sections.content: It is normal for your skin to appear red (similar to sunburn) and feel warm for 1–2 days. Mild swelling and sensitivity may also occur.

sections.title: Tiny Pinprick Marks
sections.content: Small pinpoint marks may be visible; these will fade as your skin heals.

sections.title: Avoid Touching the Skin
sections.content: Keep your hands clean and avoid touching or scratching the treated area for the first 24 hours.

items: No Makeup: Do not apply makeup for the first 24 hours to allow your skin to heal and to reduce the risk of infection.
Avoid Sun Exposure: Keep out of direct sunlight. Wear a wide-brimmed hat if outdoors.
Cleansing: Use only lukewarm water to rinse your face for the first 24 hours. Avoid cleansers, exfoliants, or active products until advised.
Moisturising: Apply the post-treatment serum or cream provided by your practitioner to keep the skin hydrated.
Avoid Excessive Heat: Do not use saunas, steam rooms, or hot baths.
Gentle Skincare: After 24 hours, cleanse with a mild, non-perfumed cleanser. Avoid scrubs, retinol, and acids (AHAs/BHAs) for at least 5–7 days.
Sun Protection: Apply a broad-spectrum SPF 30 or higher daily to protect healing skin.
No Swimming or Heavy Exercise: Avoid chlorinated pools, saltwater, and intense workouts for 48 hours.
Skin Changes: Mild flaking or peeling may occur — do not pick at your skin.

common_side_effects.title: Common Side Effects
items: Slight bruising from blood draw or microneedling.

emergency_guidance.title: When to Contact Us Immediately
items: Severe pain or swelling that worsens instead of improving.
Signs of infection (increasing redness, heat, pus, or fever).
Allergic reaction symptoms such as hives or difficulty breathing.

long_term_care.title: Long-Term Care
items: Maintain a consistent skincare routine with gentle cleansing, hydration, and sun protection.
For best results, a series of treatments may be recommended.
Avoid smoking and maintain a healthy lifestyle to support collagen production.
